title: DeepslateSMP
description: A german Minecraft server that uses Economy Plugins.
body:
# DeepslateSMP
DeepslateSMP is a german Minecraft server, based on multiple Mods and sub-servers, with a [Website](https://www.deepslatesmp.de/), own [Mods](https://deepslatesmp.de/mods/), and a small community. On DeepslateSMP, there are multiple cool mods, you can sell, buy, and trade, you have teams, a balance, etc.!
